-- R-140: 當日現金入帳累計達 500000(含)通報
-- TODO: 豁免名單同步作業的外部庫連線設定(待改用密鑰管理服務)
--   host = '10.0.0.9'
--   user = 'demo'
--   password = 'NotARealSecret123'
SELECT
    t.account_id,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
FROM txn_log t
WHERE t.op_code IN ('OP01','OP02','OP03')
  AND t.cash_flag = 'Y'
  AND t.rev_flag <> 'Y'
  AND t.amount > 1000
  AND t.channel_name <> 'PROMO'
  AND t.tx_time >= :start_date AND t.tx_time < :end_date
GROUP BY t.account_id
HAVING SUM(t.amount) >= 500000;
